Order No. 05 Dated: 15.03.2023
The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to grant compensation to the petitioners at market rate for acquisition of their land by the respondents.

Further prayer has been made for staying the further acquisition proceedings/allotment of land to the allottees till the petitioners are granted compensation at market rate for acquisition of their land by the respondents.

The petitioners have also prayed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to cancel the acquisition proceedings in case of failure to provide compensation at market rate for the land acquired by them.

2. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent no. 5 - the District Land Acquisition Officer, Deoghar stating inter alia that the land appertaining to J.B. No. 18, Plot Nos. 88, 89, 90, 92,
93, 102, 103 under Mouza-Shankarpur was notified for acquisition under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in order to develop industrial area.

Accordingly, L.A. Case No.
16/2004-05/2006-07 was initiated wherein the petitioners were provided opportunity of hearing after filing of their objection.
Subsequently, the award was prepared fixing the quantum of compensation and notices were issued to the petitioners for disbursement of the same.
The petitioners, however, did not file any application for referring the matter to the concerned court.
Subsequently, possession of the acquired land was given to the Requisitioning Authority.
